customer_decision_state: The customer already accepts the category but cannot confidently self-select among services, formulations, routes or care options.
first_persuasive_job: Reduce option ambiguity by making the path to the right fit legible, bounded and explainable.
fit_boundary: Creative Fit decides BW-F05 before Production Feasibility. Asset quantity, rights clarity, pricing completeness and social-proof availability cannot switch the Family.

reference_companies.decision_state: Customer knows skincare but cannot self-select the right care without analysis.
reference_companies.within_family_distinctiveness: Analysis-to-personalized-formulation routing; diagnosis and explanation can carry the journey.

reference_companies.decision_state: Customer wants a low-friction answer to what current skin care is appropriate.
reference_companies.within_family_distinctiveness: Lighter counseling/measurement/self-serve route; must not clone APEX's deeper diagnostic topology.

compatible_module_grammar.role: guided choice entry; one legible decision at a time
state known/unknown or recommendation boundary next to claim
intent-routed service field; not equal generic cards
commitment ladder only when terms are verified
state-specific next event such as analysis/counseling

prohibited_or_misfit_grammar: fixed equal-card matrix as the family implementation
BW-F08-style category education when the category is already accepted
atmosphere-first opening that delays the actual option ambiguity
single universal sticky CTA that ignores decision state
recommendation claims without source-bounded diagnostic basis

art_direction_contract.hero: Expose the unresolved choice or diagnostic entry immediately; show a route, not a product-card wall.
art_direction_contract.media: Use measurement, consultation, service-context or diagnostic-state media only when provenance/rights are safe; media must clarify the choice rather than decorate it.
art_direction_contract.typography: Prioritize labels, state changes and route hierarchy; ornamental display typography is secondary to decision clarity.
art_direction_contract.density: Progressive disclosure: concise choice framing early, denser evidence only at the branch where it matters.
art_direction_contract.cta: Move from low-friction self-placement/analysis toward a concrete next event; CTA wording must reflect current decision state.
art_direction_contract.responsive: On 320–430px, expose one readable route at a time; do not compress multiple routes into horizontal micro-cards. Preserve recommendation boundary adjacent to the relevant choice.

collision_rules.discriminator: F05 when category acceptance exists and option selection is the blocker; F08 when understanding the category/self-placement precedes option choice.
collision_rules.human_review_trigger: category acceptance cannot be established from verified company/customer truth

collision_rules.discriminator: F05 when route selection is the first job; F02 when safety/suitability/wrong-choice reassurance is the first job.
collision_rules.human_review_trigger: diagnostic routing and safety reassurance are co-equal before any useful next event

anti_template_requirements: APEX and FANCL must not share the same hero silhouette, route count, module sequence and CTA choreography merely because both are F05.
A service/diagnostic path must be authored from actual option structure; generic 3-card geometry is not evidence of Guided Choice.
Compared with Nagi F08, the page must move quickly from accepted category to selection logic rather than replay category education.
Color/photo/logo/copy substitution alone is a template-swap failure.

production_feasibility_separate_profile.allowed_effect: After Family freeze, may alter media realization, proof placement, or unavailable module variants while preserving the decision-routing logic.
